item.title: Explore! Add-On
item.creator: Tsunami Studios
item.description:
Explore is a light-weight, universal tool and equipment Add-On designed to enhance travel and adventure in any world! Climb mountains and traverse canyons with ease. Reduce fall damage and swim faster than ever before. 

Includes:

-Grappling hook
-Hang glider
-Slime boots (Bouncy)
-Climbing pick
-Rope
-Snorkel
-Flippers
-Sleeping bag (Sleep without resetting spawn point)
item.changelog: Explore is now Vibrant Visuals compatible.

faqEntries.heading: How do you craft the tools?
faqEntries.content: Craft new tools with a new material, Fiber, dropped from breaking grass. Fiber can be crafted into rope, and fiber or rope will be used in all other crafting recipes.

faqEntries.heading: What is added to the game in Explore?
faqEntries.content: A set of tools and equipment intended to make exploration of your world easier and more fun.

faqEntries.heading: What mechanics will I need to learn?
faqEntries.content: Each item added ties into vanilla mechanics with their own twist. Some enhance those features, like Flippers making swimming faster, while some add totally new mechanics, like the Grappling Hook.

faqEntries.heading: Are these items hard to craft?
faqEntries.content: Each item is balanced around early game and can be easily crafted. This Add-On will make it easier to explore your world right from the start.

item.howToTitle: Add to new or existing world!

howToEntries.heading: Swing on the Grappling Hook
howToEntries.content: Craft with rope, a crossbow, and a tripwire hook, and fire the Grappling Hook to swing around your world.

howToEntries.heading: Fly with the Hangglider
howToEntries.content: Craft the Hang Glider with sticks, carpets, and rope. Jump from a high place and soar the skies. Combine with a grappling hook to regain height, and fly as far as you want.

howToEntries.heading: Defy death with the Slime Shoes
howToEntries.content: Drop from as high as you want, you’ll just bounce! All fall damage is reduced to zero. This useful effect combines well with Elytras, as well as Grappling Hooks and Hang Gliders. Be careful the shoes don’t run out of durability mid-jump… though more can always be crafted with slime and rope.

howToEntries.heading: Speed up with Flippers
howToEntries.content: Crossing the oceans or diving deep, the flippers make your underwater swimming faster. When swimming prone, gain a significant speed boost. Craft with leather and rope.

howToEntries.heading: Explore Oceans with the Snorkel
howToEntries.content: Exploring underwater becomes much easier with the Snorkel, which provides underwater breathing near the surface, allowing prone swimming without the need to come up for air. Or peer into the depths from above. Craft with leather, glass, bamboo/sugarcane, and rope.

howToEntries.heading: Scale cliffs with the Climbing Picks
howToEntries.content: Use the climbing pick to scale up mountains and down ravines. Craft with iron, sticks, and rope.
